result.instructions: Use ask_user_questions for structured choices and request_plan_approval for a concrete plan. These MCP calls wait for an explicit human decision. Do not invoke them through a shell or in the background. Do not treat an error or a missing response as consent. Plan acceptance preserves the session's Allow permissions.

tools.description: Ask up to three structured questions and wait for the user's explicit answer. Use stable question and option IDs. Select single_select for mutually exclusive choices and multi_select for independent choices. Enable allow_free_form for custom answers. A user may omit questions when answering. Run this helper in the foreground and wait for its result before continuing.

question_type.description: Whether the reader may select one option or several independent options.

tools.name: ask_user_questions

tools.description: Present a concrete plan and wait for the user's explicit decision. Supply its title and full Markdown plan. Acceptance authorizes this plan and preserves the session's Allow permissions. Rejection requires you to revise the plan using the feedback. Run this helper in the foreground and wait for its result before continuing.

plan.description:
The complete plan in well-structured Markdown: the intended steps,
what each one touches, and any decisions already settled.

title.description: A concise title naming what the plan will do.

tools.name: request_plan_approval
